bombard_context.begin: patch_Unit_bombard_tile records source unit and wrapped target tile before calling Civ III
bombard_context.release: patch_Unit_play_anim_for_bombard_tile plus the M7.4 native action cursor exposes authored release markers
bombard_context.impact: patch_Units_Image_Data_load_animated_effect observes Civ III's AE_Hit/AE_Miss load at the exact native damage-animation boundary
bombard_context.finish: patch_Unit_bombard_tile return closes the action after Civ III has resolved all fire-rate rolls
bombard_context.precision_strike: patch_Unit_do_precision_strike and its existing bombing/cruise-missile replacement calls provide source and target context
bombard_context.defensive_bombard: existing Fighter combat hooks provide source, target, and interruption context

pixel_suppression.ordinary_effect_loader: patch_Units_Image_Data_load_animated_effect calls Civ III first, then clears only byte 0x184 of the returned FLC_Animation after the renderer accepts ownership
pixel_suppression.standalone_animation_loader: Units_Image_Data_load_animation must become an inlead so renderer-owned standalone effects such as Art\Animations\SDI\SDI.ini can use the same post-load byte-0x184 suppression
pixel_suppression.native_draw_rule: Animator_update ticks the FLC before testing byte 0x184 and calling the sprite blitter, so zero suppresses pixels without suppressing tick, sound cues, dirty accounting, waits, or object lifetime
pixel_suppression.field_access: write only the low byte of FLC_Animation.Last, which is the header name for offset 0x184; do not zero the whole trailing word because bytes 0x185 and 0x186 have separate native meanings
pixel_suppression.ownership_gate: clear the byte only after the matching custom event/body/effect family has been accepted; unmapped or failed families remain entirely native

native_bridge.outcome_policy: The effect call says hit/miss and timing, not what gameplay object changed. Damage, death, building loss, population loss, and tile changes come from authoritative before/after Civ III state.

nuclear_policy.delivery: Unit::animate_nuclear_strike runs before Civ III chooses the presentation branch and is never evidence of detonation
nuclear_policy.predicate: after finding the first eligible SDI civilization, intercepted means intercepting_civ_id != -1 and rand_int(4) != 0; otherwise the strike detonates
nuclear_policy.detonated_boundary: Unit::do_nuke_tile is the authoritative detonation branch in offline play and the multiplayer sync callback
nuclear_policy.intercepted_boundary: Unit::get_intercepted_as_nuke is the authoritative interception branch in offline play and the multiplayer sync callback
nuclear_policy.local_visuals: successful delivery uses the missile unit animation path; interception loads Art\Animations\SDI\SDI.ini as a standalone FLC
nuclear_policy.rule: never infer detonation from the delivery clip, attack clip, disappearance of the missile, an explosion size, or victim despawn

ownership.custom_unit_and_effect: replace the custom unit body and related native impact pixels as one atomic presentation family
ownership.native_unit: leave its baked attack/projectile/explosion art completely native
ownership.missing_custom_effect: visible hard failure for the custom effect; never replay the native pixels behind an already-custom unit
ownership.native_audio_preservation: suppress only native effect pixels after their animation/audio state has been created and advanced

bindings.selection: per-unit or per-attack data in the renderer pack; no unit-name branches
bindings.multiple_releases: one child release event per authored marker
bindings.multiple_impacts: one child impact event per native AE_Hit/AE_Miss call; decorative sub-bursts never imply extra gameplay damage

rendering.depth: world-anchored particles depth-test against the map scene; soft sprites do not write depth
rendering.zoom: profile-authored normal and reduced-scale density/size limits preserve Civ III readability
rendering.night: flash and emissive sprites use the shared environment; transient light lifetime is bounded by the event
rendering.visibility: never spawn or keep redrawing a fog-hidden or off-screen effect solely to reveal information
rendering.persistent_damage: scorch, crater, smoke, or fire persists only when authoritative map state or an explicit presentation event owns it

cleanup.normal: complete at the profile impact duration
cleanup.interrupted: terminate or authored-short-fade at the native interruption timestamp
cleanup.reset_load_or_device_loss: drop all transient GPU instances and rebuild only from still-live captured events
cleanup.source_or_target_despawn: do not retarget; finish only if the event policy explicitly allows detached impact presentation

confirmed_civ3: Unit::play_bombard_damage_animation maps hits to AE_Hit/AE_Hit2/AE_Hit3/AE_Hit5 and misses to AE_Miss/AE_WaterMiss
Civ III creates an AnimatedEffect at the target, queues AT_DEATH, and waits 500 ms in offline play
Units_Image_Data_load_animated_effect and Fighter_do_bombard_tile already have inlead entries
ordinary bombard fire animation runs before Fighter_do_bombard_tile resolves outcomes
Animator_update ticks each effect FLC before byte 0x184 gates its pixel blit, so clearing only that byte preserves native advancement and sound
Unit::do_nuke_tile and Unit::get_intercepted_as_nuke are the exact detonation/interception branches and are reused by the multiplayer sync callback
confirmed_civ6: VFX.blp and VFX_A/B/C.blp contain named muzzle, shell, bomb, missile, explosion, debris, water-impact, and nuclear families
22 standalone SHARED_DATA texture resources in the conservative mapping convert to generic DDS payloads
